subject: HelioMed security discovery — next steps & containment/DR evidence
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Sarah White <sarah.white@heliomed.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Apr 2026 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: HelioMed security discovery — next steps & containment/DR evidence

Hi Sarah — thanks again for taking the demo earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on the compliance items you raised.

Recap (from our call)
- SOC 2: Redwood completed a SOC 2 Type II assessment in 2025; scope includes serving runtime, control plane, and console. Full assertion available on request.
- Data protection: Redwood supports GDPR controls; for HIPAA we offer Private deployments and a BAA for customers that require it.
- IR / breach notif: we operate an IR playbook and can produce redacted incident timelines and notification templates.

What we can provide now (attached / links)
- redwood-soc2-summary-2025.pdf (summary + scope)
- redwood-ir-playbook-v2.pdf (redacted playbook + roles/responsibilities)
- redwood-bcp-summary-2026.pdf (high-level RTO/RPO and cross-region recovery flow)

What we need from HelioMed
- Completed vendor security questionnaire (attached to your reply works)
- Confirmation if you need BAA language up front (we can loop Legal)
- Any specific evidence you want prioritized (e.g., encryption at rest, key management model, notification SLAs)

Proposed timeline
- HelioMed: initial questionnaire or list of prioritized items by 2026-04-12 EOD
- Redwood: provide any additional artifacts and answers by 2026-04-14
- Security deep-dive call: propose 2026-04-14 10:00 AM PT (30–45 min)

Ben and Marissa are looped for technical and operational artifacts. Neha is on compliance and will help coordinate SOC2 materials. I’ve also added HubSpot deal link below for your reference.

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/HLM-2026-0042

Thanks — happy to adjust timelines if you need faster turnaround.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachment stubs: redwood-soc2-summary-2025.pdf (PDF), redwood-ir-playbook-v2.pdf (PDF), redwood-bcp-summary-2026.pdf (ZIP - doc summaries)

From: Sarah White <sarah.white@heliomed.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Kevin Miller <kevin.miller@heliomed.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Apr 2026 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HelioMed security discovery — next steps & containment/DR evidence

Rachel — thanks for the summary and the materials. A few clarifying items from our side before we kick off the questionnaire:

1) SOC 2: can you confirm whether the 2025 Type II report is a full report that we can receive under an NDA or if you provide a SOC 2 assertion only? We typically request the full report for our risk review.
2) HIPAA / BAA: HelioMed will need a BAA for any Protected Health Information. Please loop legal or send your standard BAA template.
3) Breach notification timeline: we need to confirm the timing you commit to for initial customer notification (we typically require initial notification within 72 hours of detection, and periodic updates thereafter).
4) DR/BCP: please include RTO/RPO targets and any customer-impact scenarios (region failure, data corruption).

I’ve attached our vendor questionnaire (Helio_Vendor_Sec_Q_2026.xlsx). Would you prefer to complete it directly or have us mark the sections you want Redwood to answer first?

Target from HelioMed: we’d like initial evidence (SOC2 assertion or summary + breach notif statement + contact for legal/BAA) by 2026-04-12 EOD if possible — that will let our InfoSec team start the risk review. If that timeline is tight, please let me know.

Also looping Kevin Miller (Infra) — Kevin, can you join the deep-dive on 4/14 if needed?

Thanks,
Sarah White
Head of Information Security | HelioMed
sarah.white@heliomed.com

Attachment: Helio_Vendor_Sec_Q_2026.xlsx (Excel)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sarah White <sarah.white@heliomed.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Apr 2026 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HelioMed security discovery — next steps & containment/DR evidence

Sarah — appreciate the clear asks. Quick answers and pointers (technical):

- SOC 2: Redwood can provide the full SOC 2 Type II report under a standard NDA. The 2025 report covers the period Jan–Dec 2025 and includes the serving runtime, control plane, and console. I’ve attached a short assertion pdf for immediate review and we can share the full report after NDA.
- Encryption / KMS: For Redwood Hosted we use cloud provider KMS (AWS KMS) with customer or service-side CMKs; for Dedicated and Private deployments customers can bring their own keys via customer-managed KMS/HSM integrations.
- Incident notification: Our policy is to provide an initial notification within 24 hours of confirmed incidents that materially impact customers, with a formal notification package (timeline, impact, mitigation) within 72 hours. We will work with legal to tailor language for regulated customers.
- BCP/DR targets: typical targets: control-plane failover RTO ~4 hours (automated cross-region failover), data recovery RTO up to 24 hours for full restore depending on recovery stage; RPO depends on workload but we aim for 1 hour for customer-facing stateful systems; we will provide the BCP summary doc.

Availability for a technical deep-dive: Thu 4/14 10:00–11:00 AM PT / Fri 4/15 8:00–9:30 AM PT. If 4/14 works we’ll bring the infra and SRE leads.

Ben Carter
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0147

Attachment: redwood-soc2-assertion-2025.pdf (PDF)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah White <sarah.white@heliomed.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Apr 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HelioMed security discovery — next steps & containment/DR evidence

Hi Sarah — adding operational context from the BCP side:

- Runbook & drills: Redwood runs quarterly disaster recovery drills for cross-region failover and monthly runbook validations for critical subsystems. We can share sanitized drill summaries and redacted incident timelines under NDA.
- RTO/RPO (summarized): Control plane — RTO target 4 hours, RPO near-zero for configuration state using continuous replication; Serving runtime — RTO target 1–6 hours depending on scale; Data restores can vary, full restore RTO up to 24 hours in worst-case scenarios.
- Notification cadence: initial alerting within 24 hours; we provide regular status updates (every 6–12 hours) until containment and then a closure report.

If HelioMed needs runbook-level artifacts for compliance I can prepare a tailored pack and a sample redacted incident timeline (NDA required). Also happy to share the BCP checklist we use for customer onboardings.

Marissa Cole
Director, Site Reliability | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood-bcp-summary-2026.pdf (PDF)

From: Sarah White <sarah.white@heliomed.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Kevin Miller <kevin.miller@heliomed.com>, Legal <legal@heliomed.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HelioMed security discovery — next steps & containment/DR evidence

Thanks — that helps a lot. We’ll do the following on our side:
- Review the attached PDFs and Ben’s answers; we’ll return the completed questionnaire (Helio_Vendor_Sec_Q_2026.xlsx) by 2026-04-12 EOD.
- Legal will reach out regarding the BAA (cc’d). If you can share your standard BAA template that will speed the process.
- We confirm the 4/14 10:00 AM PT deep-dive — Kevin and I will be on the call; please send calendar invite and dial-in.

Two quick asks before the call:
1) Please upload the SOC2 assertion or NDA instructions to the Drive link so our legal/compliance team can access it ahead of the meeting.
2) Flag any items in the questionnaire you want prioritized (particularly BAA, breach notif timelines, encryption/KMS).

I appreciate the quick turnaround — this is a priority for our procurement window.

Best,
Sarah White
Head of Information Security | HelioMed
